claim: AWS uses traffic policing on hosted connections: when the traffic rate reaches the configured maximum rate, excess traffic is dropped, so bursty traffic can get a lower throughput than non-bursty traffic.
question: What happens to traffic above the configured rate on a hosted connection?

evidence.quote: AWS uses traffic policing on hosted connections, which means that when the traffic rate reaches the configured maximum rate, excess traffic is dropped. This might result in bursty traffic having a lower throughput than non-bursty traffic.

claim: The MTU of a Direct Connect private virtual interface can be either 1500 or 9001 (jumbo frames).
question: Which MTU values can a Direct Connect private virtual interface use?

evidence.quote: The MTU of a private virtual interface can be either 1500 or 9001 (jumbo frames).

claim: The MTU of a Direct Connect transit virtual interface can be either 1500 or 8500 (jumbo frames).
question: Which MTU values can a Direct Connect transit virtual interface use?

evidence.quote: The MTU of a transit virtual interface can be either 1500 or 8500 (jumbo frames).
Yes, a transit virtual interface will support jumbo frames. Maximum transmission unit (MTU) size will be limited to 8,500.

claim: Setting a virtual interface to jumbo frames can update the underlying physical connection, and that update disrupts connectivity for all virtual interfaces on the connection for up to 30 seconds.
question: What happens to a connection when you enable jumbo frames on a virtual interface?

evidence.quote: Setting the MTU of a virtual interface to 8500 (jumbo frames) or 9001 (jumbo frames) can cause an update to the underlying physical connection if it wasn't updated to support jumbo frames. Updating the connection disrupts network connectivity for all virtual interfaces associated with the connection for up to 30 seconds.

claim: If two private virtual interfaces advertise the same route with different MTU values, or a Site-to-Site VPN advertises the same route, an MTU of 1500 is used.
question: Which MTU is used when the same route is advertised over interfaces with different MTUs or over a VPN?

evidence.quote: If you have two private virtual interfaces that advertise the same route but use different MTU values, or if you have a Site-to-Site VPN that advertise the same route, 1500 MTU is used.

claim: Jumbo frames on Transit Gateways support only 8500 bytes.
question: What jumbo frame size does a transit gateway support over Direct Connect?

evidence.quote: Jumbo frames on Transit Gateways support only 8500 bytes.
